method.decay: annualized % = exp(slope of OLS ln(on_demand_median) vs years)-1; 52w window and since first week.
method.supply: Windows 4/13/26 weeks. price_change_Nw = on-demand median vs N weeks earlier; offering/provider_change_Nw = pct change of 3-week-mean counts. 5 regime labels per window (regime_Nw): |price| or |offering| < 2.0 pct (unrounded) = mixed; price down + offering up = loosening; price up + offering down = tightening; both up = demandUp; both down = demandDown. supply_regime = regime_13w. Early warning (early_warning): 4w regime not mixed, differs from 13w regime, and the 4w regime one week earlier is the same.
method.spot_discount: (1 - spot_median/on_demand_median)*100 at latest week and N weeks earlier. Spot-unreliable rule: a week whose spot median > on-demand median is unreliable (spot_unreliable_latest / spot_unreliable_Nw_ago; page shows it as not comparable).
